rough Ziztu's MCP server.
# Ziztu for DeepSeek Harness
Plan, write and make micro dramas and anime episodes from your DeepSeek Harness agent. This plugin c
onnects the harness to Ziztu's hosted MCP server with your own API key, so the agent gets Ziztu's to
ols as `mcp__ziztu__<tool>`.
- Adds 30 tools: create a project, plan an episode with the Director, write and edit scripts, price

any step, make first frames, animate shots, make music, export the film, and follow the jobs.
- Adds
a **Ziztu** page to Settings: paste your API key, see the connection status and the tool list, and

read a short list of things to ask.
- Spending stays under your control. Every tool that spends cred
its needs a `max_credits` cap, anything above 500 credits needs a `confirm`, and `dry_run` returns t

he price without starting anything. These rules are enforced by Ziztu's API, not by this plugin.
- T
he key is kept in the harness's own credential store on your computer (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`
, readable by you alone; the plugin falls back to `$DSH_HOME/ziztu/settings.json` if a composition h
as no credential store). It is sent only to the server address in Settings (https://getziztu.com/mcp

by default).
- No dependencies. The plugin talks to the server with Node's built-in `fetch`, and it
s settings page uses the React that the harness already provides.
Licence: MIT. This is a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It is made by the Ziztu team and is n
ot made or endorsed by DeepSeek.
## Install
You need DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) 0.2.x and a Ziztu API key. Make a key in the Ziztu studio at https
://getziztu.com/app under Settings, API keys. Give it the `read` scope to look around, and add `gene
rate` to make things and `export` to download films. A new account has free credits for scripts, cha
racter art and storyboards.
Pick one way to install.
**From the Plugins page (any version of `dsh`):** open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter
he Plugins page (any version of `dsh`):** open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

- `dsh-plugin-ziztu` (the npm package)
- `https://github.com/0xnirlin/dsh-plugin-ziztu` (this reposi

tory)
- the path of a local checkout of this repository
**From the command line:**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or straight from GitHub, or from a local folder:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin` hands the arguments to pnpm in the profile folder and selects the bundle. Restart `dsh
web` if the page does not show **Ziztu** under Settings.
**Add the Ziztu plugin index (optional):** with the experimental **Custom plugin markets** bundle on
, open **Plugins**, **Discover**, **Add index source** and enter `https://getziztu.com/dsh/plugins.j
n **Plugins**, **Discover**, **Add index source** and enter `https://getziztu.com/dsh/plugins.json`.
## Connect

1. Open **Settings**, then **Ziztu**.
2. Paste your key and choose **Save and connect**. The status

changes to "30 tools ready".
3. Start a session and ask for something. Examples:
- "Plan a 60 second
vertical micro drama about a baker who finds a love letter in the dough. Show me the price before y

ou make anything."
- "Write the script for episode one of an anime about a lighthouse keeper, then t

urn it into a shot list."
- "Make the first frames for this project with a cap of 200 credits."
- "W
hat is my credit balance, and what is the status of my jobs?"
Other ways to give the plugin a key, in order of priority: the Settings page (stored under the name
`ZIZTU_API_KEY`), the plugin row's `config` (`apiKey`, and `url` for another server address), then t
he `ZIZTU_API_KEY` environment variable (`ZIZTU_TOKEN` also works).
## Notes
- **Full connector only.** The plugin uses an API key, which the full connector at `/mcp` accepts. Z
iztu's planner edition (`/mcp/planner`, no tools that make media) takes an OAuth sign-in only, which
this plugin does not do. If you want the planner, add it with the harness's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-m

cp-client` instead.
- **Tool names.** They follow the same shape as the harness's MCP client: `mcp__
ziztu__list_projects`, `mcp__ziztu__quote`, and so on. Do not also add a second MCP client row named

`ziztu`.
- **Long calls.** Calls time out after 180 seconds. Script drafts return a job id and are

followed with `get_script_job`.
- **Permissions.** Ziztu tools run under your harness's normal tool
approval. Read the `max_credits` value before you approve a call that spends credits.
## Develop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Layout: `index.js` is the Host half (connection, tool registration, the settings routes under `/api/
ziztu`), `client.js` is the browser half (the Settings page), `src/` holds the small Streamable HTTP
client, the tool bridge, the settings store and the request fence. `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the pl
ugin; `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` and `dsh.client`.

- Ziztu: https://getziztu.com
- Setup guide: https://getziztu.com/connect/deepseek-harness
- Ziztu M

CP docs: https://getziztu.com/docs/mcp
- Issues: https://github.com/0xnirlin/dsh-plugin-ziztu/issues
